text_blocks.text:
1. The quorum for a meeting of the Board of Directors of a company shall be one-third of its total strength or two directors, whichever is higher.
   — Companies Act 2013, s.174 [4:146]
2. The quorum for a meeting of the Board shall be one-third of the total strength of directors, subject to a minimum of three.
   — Companies Act 2013, s.378V [716:839]
